definitions.conditional_mean: mean over all valid response tokens exceeding threshold, pooled across 512 responses; zero only if no exceedance
definitions.gradient: Recorded mean of four pre-clipping sequential optimizer-update gradient norms; not frozen whole-cohort norm
definitions.timing: p0 recorded before the first update of this round; q recorded at historical generation; gradient norms during four sequential updates

severity_vs_mean_grad.inference: Descriptive same-round association of temporally dependent points; not independent trials or causal evidence.
